newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police in fresh search in child sex case.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police in fresh search in child sex case.

text.p: Belgian police said on Tuesday they searched a photography shop in Charleroi, south of Brussels, as part of an investigation into the country's child sex, kidnap and murder scandal.

The search was the first in several weeks in the investigation which started in mid-August with the rescue of two teenagers from the hands of a convicted child rapist and was followed by the discovery of five bodies on his properties.
Four were of young girls, while the fifth was of a man linked to a gang allegedly led by the rapist Marc Dutroux, who arrested after a tipoff.
At least a dozen people have been arrested in connection with the case, which has shocked the country.

Police said they confiscated boxes of negatives in the latest search. The shop was also scanned with sophisticated British ground radar equipment which can detect cavities. A sniffer dog was also used.
A police spokesman declined to comment on the reasons behind the search or its outcome. The photographer, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters he had nothing to do with the case.
